description: This file defines the Transaction class and related operations for managing nftables transactions, including methods for adding, creating, inserting, replacing, flushing, and deleting nftables objects, as well as generating command strings.

classes.name: Transaction
classes.description: Represents an nftables transaction with methods to manipulate nftables objects.

classes.name: operation
classes.description: Internal struct representing a single nftables operation within a transaction.

classes.name: verb
classes.description: Type alias for string, representing nft command verbs like add, create, insert, etc.

methods.name: populateCommandBuf
methods.description: Populates the transaction as a series of nft commands into a bytes.Buffer.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns the transaction as a string containing nft commands, including error comments if any.

methods.name: NumOperations
methods.description: Returns the number of operations queued in the transaction.

methods.name: operation
methods.description: Internal method to add an operation with a specific verb and object to the transaction.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds an 'nft add' operation, ensuring the object exists or is created.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Adds an 'nft create' operation to create a new object.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Adds an 'nft insert' operation to insert an object at the start of its chain.

methods.name: Replace
methods.description: Adds an 'nft replace' operation to replace an existing object.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Adds an 'nft flush' operation to clear the contents of an object.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Adds an 'nft delete' operation to delete an object.
